studies.title: Nattokinase and Arterial Plaque
studies.tested: Nattokinase, an enzyme from natto (fermented soybeans), 6,000 FU a day
studies.who: 1,062 participants
studies.result: The study reported a reduction in common carotid IMT (the thickness of the artery wall in the neck) and in plaque size.

links.label: Ongoing trial: nattokinase and inflammation markers

studies.title: Cherries and Gout Attacks
studies.tested: Cherries or cherry extract eaten in the 2 days before (about half a cup, 10 to 12 cherries)
studies.who: 633 people with gout
studies.result: Eating cherries in the previous 2 days was linked to a 35% lower chance of a gout attack, and 75% lower for people also taking allopurinol. This kind of study shows a link, not proof.

studies.title: Exercise Lying Down for POTS
studies.tested: Exercise done lying back or seated (recumbent bike, rowing, swimming), built up from 10-20 minutes to 40-45 minutes, 4 to 6 days a week
studies.who: People with POTS
studies.result: Among people who finished the program, 71% no longer met the criteria for POTS. That number only counts the people who finished.

studies.title: Pumpkin Seeds for Prostate (GRANU)
studies.tested: Pumpkin seed extract, plain pumpkin seeds, or a placebo
studies.who: 1,431 men aged 50 to 80 with enlarged prostate symptoms
studies.result: The pumpkin seed extract did no better than the placebo. Plain pumpkin seeds did a little better (58.5% improved vs 47.3% on placebo), but that part wasn't fully blinded.

studies.title: The Tomato Trial That Never Started (SOLANUM)
studies.tested: Lycopene (from tomatoes), 28 mg a day
studies.who: Planned: people with plaque in the neck (carotid) arteries
studies.result: Withdrawn before anyone enrolled because of lack of funding. There are no results.

studies.title: Vitamin D and Autoimmune Disease (VITAL)
studies.tested: Vitamin D, 2,000 units a day, vs a placebo
studies.who: 25,871 adults (men 50+, women 55+)
studies.result: Fewer people on vitamin D got an autoimmune disease: 123 vs 155 on placebo, 22% fewer. The result was right on the edge of counting as real. Fish oil in the same trial made no clear difference.

studies.title: Vitamin D Doses for MS
studies.tested: Vitamin D, 1,000 vs 4,000 units a day, in winter
studies.who: 89 people with relapsing remitting MS
studies.result: Completed in April 2018, but no results were ever posted on the trial registry.

studies.title: Interval Walking for Rheumatoid Arthritis
studies.tested: Walking 3 times a week, 30 minutes, with 10 bursts of at least 1 minute at high effort
studies.who: 12 inactive adults with rheumatoid arthritis, average age 64
studies.result: Disease activity scores dropped 38% and fitness went up about 9%. Only 12 people and no comparison group.

studies.title: Meditation and Yoga for Lupus
studies.tested: Group sessions of meditation, yoga, group talks and deep breathing
studies.who: 30 people with lupus
studies.result: Completed in June 2018, but no results were ever posted on the trial registry.

studies.title: Raw Plant Diet and Lupus
studies.tested: Mostly raw, whole-food plant diet heavy on leafy greens, with flax or chia seeds and lots of water
studies.who: 3 women with lupus and Sjogren's
studies.result: The report says nearly all symptoms faded within 4 weeks, and two stayed symptom-free 6+ years with no recent medication. Only 3 people, and the lead author sells a program for this diet.

studies.title: The Devil's Claw Trial
studies.tested: Devil's claw, 240, 960 or 1,920 mg a day, vs a placebo
studies.who: 67 adults over 40 with knee or hip osteoarthritis
studies.result: Stopped after an unexpected withdrawal of funding. 53 people finished, but the results page says zero people were analyzed, so there's no answer.

studies.title: Butterbur for Migraine
studies.tested: Butterbur root extract, 75 mg or 50 mg twice a day, vs a placebo
studies.who: 245 adults with 2 to 6 migraine attacks a month
studies.result: On 75 mg twice a day, attacks dropped 48% vs 26% on placebo. The 50 mg dose didn't beat placebo by enough to count. Raw butterbur has chemicals that can damage the liver; the trial used a specially processed extract.

studies.title: Ginger for a Migraine Attack
studies.tested: Ginger extract, 400 mg, added to IV ketoprofen, vs a placebo
studies.who: 60 adults having a migraine attack in an emergency room
studies.result: The ginger group did better at 1, 1.5 and 2 hours, with less pain and better function. Ginger was added to strong pain medicine, not tested on its own.

studies.title: Compression for POTS
studies.tested: Compression garments: none, lower legs, belly and thighs, or full belly and legs
studies.who: 30 adults with POTS
studies.result: Heart rate averaged 109 with no compression, 103 legs only, 97 belly and thighs, and 92 full belly and legs. Symptoms improved too. It was a lab test, not daily life.

studies.title: Fasting for Rheumatoid Arthritis (NutriFast)
studies.tested: A 7-day fast, then a plant-based diet for 11 weeks, vs standard healthy eating advice
studies.who: 53 people with rheumatoid arthritis
studies.result: The fasting group improved within the first week. Both groups improved by 12 weeks and the main goal showed no clear winner, but 9 in the fasting group vs 3 on the standard diet reached a big improvement (ACR50).

studies.title: Saw Palmetto Plus Nettle (PRO 160/120)
studies.tested: 160 mg saw palmetto + 120 mg nettle root, one capsule twice a day, vs a placebo
studies.who: 257 older men with enlarged prostate symptoms
studies.length: 24 weeks, then 24 more weeks on the herbs
studies.result: Symptom scores dropped 6 points with the herbs vs 4 with placebo. Side effects were about the same as placebo. A real but modest difference.

studies.title: Fasting Two Days a Week for Diabetes (EARLY)
studies.tested: 5:2 meal replacement plan vs metformin vs empagliflozin
studies.who: 405 adults with newly found type 2 diabetes and overweight
studies.result: A1c dropped 1.9 points with 5:2 fasting vs 1.6 on metformin and 1.5 on empagliflozin, and the fasting group lost the most weight (about 9.7 kg). Short trial, and people knew which group they were in.

studies.title: Vitamin E for Fatty Liver
studies.tested: Vitamin E 800 units a day vs pioglitazone vs a placebo
studies.who: 247 adults with NASH (a serious kind of fatty liver) without diabetes
studies.result: Liver damage scores improved in 43% on vitamin E vs 19% on placebo. Pioglitazone (34%) didn't count as significant. Liver fat and inflammation went down, but scarring didn't improve.

studies.title: Coffee and Liver Scarring
studies.tested: Coffee drinking (highest vs lowest)
studies.who: 11 studies; 4,303 people with fatty liver in the scarring analysis
studies.result: No clear link between coffee and getting or having fatty liver. Among people who already had it, coffee drinkers had 35% lower odds of serious liver scarring. Observational studies, so a link, not proof.

studies.title: Melatonin for Migraine
studies.tested: Melatonin vs placebo (and vs amitriptyline)
studies.who: 9 trials, 788 people with migraine
studies.result: Vs placebo, melatonin cut about 1.5 headache days, lowered pain, shortened attacks by almost 5 hours and meant less pain medicine. Amitriptyline worked better on several measures, but melatonin caused less sleepiness.

studies.title: Putting Diabetes Into Remission (DiRECT)
studies.tested: Stopping diabetes medicines, a formula diet of 825 to 853 calories a day for 3 to 5 months, then slow food reintroduction with support
studies.who: 306 adults aged 20 to 65, diagnosed in the last 6 years
studies.result: 46% of the program group were in remission at 12 months, off all diabetes medicine, vs 4% with usual care. 86% of people who lost 15 kg or more went into remission.

studies.title: Magnesium and Blood Pressure
studies.tested: Magnesium supplements (typical dose 365 mg a day) vs placebo
studies.who: 38 randomized trials, 2,709 people
studies.result: Magnesium lowered systolic blood pressure by 2.81 points and diastolic by 2.05 vs placebo. Bigger drops in people on blood pressure medicine (7.68) and people low on magnesium (5.97). No clear effect with normal blood pressure, and the trials varied a lot.

studies.title: Aged Garlic Extract and Blood Pressure
studies.tested: Aged garlic extract vs placebo
studies.who: 9 randomized trials, 584 people with high blood pressure
studies.result: Systolic blood pressure dropped 4.03 points. The diastolic drop (1.44) was borderline. Clear effects only at doses over 1,200 mg a day.

studies.title: The DASH Diet and Heart Risk
studies.tested: DASH diet vs fruits and vegetables diet vs typical American diet (all meals provided)
studies.who: 459 adults aged 22 to 75 without heart disease
studies.result: DASH lowered the 10-year heart disease risk score by 10.3% and the fruits and vegetables diet by 9.9% vs the typical diet. It's a risk score from blood pressure and cholesterol, not counted heart attacks.

studies.title: Yoga vs Strength Training for Knee Arthritis
studies.tested: Yoga vs strengthening exercise
studies.who: 117 adults aged 40 and up with knee osteoarthritis
studies.result: Over 12 weeks yoga reduced knee pain about the same as strengthening (not better, but just as good). By 24 weeks yoga did modestly better on several measures. Side effects were mild in both groups.

studies.title: Exercise for Migraine
studies.tested: Yoga, hard aerobic exercise, moderate steady exercise and other kinds vs medicine alone
studies.who: 28 studies, 1,501 people with migraine
studies.result: Yoga, hard aerobic and moderate steady exercise beat medicine alone for migraine frequency. Only yoga clearly lowered pain. Aerobic exercise shortened attacks. The authors rated the evidence very low quality.

studies.title: Salt for POTS
studies.tested: Very high salt diet vs very low salt diet, 6 days each
studies.who: 14 people with POTS and 13 healthy people, aged 23 to 49
studies.result: High salt lowered standing heart rate and the heart-rate jump in POTS, raised blood volume and lowered standing norepinephrine. Standing heart rate was still higher than healthy people (median 117 vs 85).

studies.title: Selenium for Hashimoto's
studies.tested: Selenium supplements vs control
studies.who: 35 studies; 869 people in the TSH analysis, 2,358 in the antibody analysis
studies.result: Selenium lowered TSH in people not on thyroid hormone and lowered thyroid antibodies (TPOAb). Side effects were similar to control. Other thyroid hormones and thyroid size didn't change. Evidence rated moderate.

studies.title: Soluble Fiber for Blood Sugar
studies.tested: Soluble fiber supplements vs control diets
studies.who: 29 randomized trials, 1,517 adults with type 2 diabetes
studies.result: Soluble fiber lowered A1c by 0.63 points and also lowered fasting blood sugar, insulin and insulin resistance. Best dose about 7.6 to 8.3 g a day. The trials varied a lot.

studies.title: Flaxseed for Fatty Liver
studies.tested: 30 g flaxseed powder a day plus health advice vs health advice only
studies.who: 50 people with fatty liver
studies.result: The flaxseed group had less liver fat (by MRI), less body and belly fat and better cholesterol and triglycerides vs their own starting point. Only 50 people.

studies.title: Turmeric (Curcumin) for Osteoarthritis
studies.tested: Turmeric extract and curcumin vs placebo and vs anti-inflammatory pain pills
studies.who: 15 randomized trials, 1,621 people with osteoarthritis
studies.result: Lowered pain and stiffness and improved function vs placebo, with similar side effects. About as good as anti-inflammatory pain pills, with fewer side effects. Best dose and product not settled.

studies.title: Bacopa for Memory and Attention
studies.tested: Standardized bacopa extract vs placebo, at least 12 weeks
studies.who: 9 trials, 518 people
studies.result: Faster on a timed attention test (Trail B) and quicker reaction time vs placebo. Mostly healthy adults. Authors say a large trial against an existing medicine is still needed.

studies.title: Ginseng for Memory
studies.tested: Ginseng preparations vs control
studies.who: 15 randomized trials, 671 people (healthy adults to Alzheimer's disease)
studies.result: Small improvement in memory, larger at high doses. No effect on overall cognition, attention or executive function. More high-quality studies needed.

studies.title: Nattospes After Stroke
studies.tested: Nattospes supplement plus standard care vs standard care alone
studies.who: 61 people in the subacute stage of ischemic stroke
studies.result: Both groups improved; the Nattospes group showed significant improvement on modified Rankin, Orgogozo and Barthel scales, with no adverse effects reported. Small, single-blinded trial.

studies.title: The MIND Diet Trial
studies.tested: MIND diet with mild calorie restriction vs control diet with mild calorie restriction
studies.who: 604 older adults with a family history of dementia
studies.result: Thinking scores improved in both groups (0.205 vs 0.170), with no significant difference. Brain MRI changes were also similar.

studies.title: East Asian Herbal Medicine for Sleep After Stroke
studies.tested: Traditional East Asian herbal medicine alone vs control
studies.who: 24 randomized trials, 1,942 people with insomnia after stroke
studies.result: Improved sleep quality and appeared safer than psychotropic drugs (except in two-week trials). Trial quality was poor and evidence was rated low or moderate.

studies.title: Aquagenic Pruritus: What Helped 36 Patients
studies.tested: Ultraviolet B light therapy and oral antihistamines (case series)
studies.who: 36 people with aquagenic pruritus
studies.result: UVB light gave significant relief to 8 of 14 (57%); antihistamines gave partial relief to 16 of 34. No control group. Authors advise checking everyone with this itch for polycythemia vera.

studies.title: Capsaicin Cream for Aquagenic Pruritus
studies.tested: Capsaicin cream 0.025%, 0.5% or 1.0% three times daily vs plain cream on other skin
studies.who: 5 people with aquagenic pruritus
studies.result: After capsaicin, contact with water no longer caused itching where capsaicin was used; areas with plain cream showed no improvement. Very small study.

studies.title: Baking Soda Baths for Aquagenic Pruritus
studies.tested: Sodium bicarbonate added to bath water; emollients for the elderly form
studies.who: 4 patients (2 aquagenic pruritus, 2 aquagenic pruritus of the elderly)
studies.result: The 2 aquagenic pruritus patients were helped by sodium bicarbonate baths; the 2 elderly patients responded to emollients. Case report; more cases needed.

studies.title: Aprepitant vs Hydroxyzine Trial (No Results Posted)
studies.tested: Aprepitant vs hydroxyzine (double blind) with cytoreductive therapy
studies.who: 63 people with myeloproliferative neoplasms and persistent aquagenic pruritus
studies.result: Completed, but no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.

studies.title: Mediterranean Diet with Olive Oil or Nuts for Cognition
studies.tested: Mediterranean diet with extra virgin olive oil or mixed nuts vs low-fat diet
studies.who: 522 older adults at high vascular risk (PREDIMED-NAVARRA)
studies.result: Both Mediterranean diet groups had higher MMSE and clock-drawing scores than the low-fat group. Differences were small.

studies.title: Ear Vagus Nerve Stimulation for POTS
studies.tested: Ear (tragus) vagus nerve stimulation vs sham on the earlobe, 1 hour daily
studies.who: 26 women with POTS
studies.result: Heart rate rise on standing was smaller with real stimulation (17.6 vs 31.7 beats/min). Inflammatory cytokines and anti-adrenergic antibodies were lower; no device side effects. Small trial.

studies.title: Beta-Sitosterol for Enlarged Prostate
studies.tested: Beta-sitosterol 20 mg three times daily vs placebo
studies.who: 200 men with symptomatic BPH
studies.result: IPSS dropped 7.4 vs 2.1 points; peak urine flow rose from 9.9 to 15.2 mL/s and residual urine fell. No change in prostate size.

studies.title: Cranberry Powder for Prostate Symptoms
studies.tested: Cranberry fruit powder 250 or 500 mg daily vs placebo
studies.who: 124 men over 45 with lower urinary tract symptoms
studies.result: IPSS fell 3.1 (250 mg) and 4.1 (500 mg) vs 1.5 on placebo, with a dose effect; urine flow improved on 500 mg. No change in blood markers.

studies.title: Pygeum africanum for Enlarged Prostate
studies.tested: Pygeum africanum extract vs placebo
studies.who: 18 randomized trials, 1,562 men with BPH
studies.result: More than twice as likely to report improved symptoms; nocturia down 19%, residual urine down 24%, peak flow up 23%. Side effects similar to placebo. Trials were small and short.

studies.title: The Saw Palmetto Trial
studies.tested: Saw palmetto extract 160 mg twice daily vs placebo
studies.who: 225 men over 49 with moderate-to-severe BPH symptoms
studies.result: No significant difference in symptom scores, urine flow, prostate size, residual volume, quality of life or PSA. Side effects similar.

studies.title: Western Plus Chinese Medicine for Stroke Rehab
studies.tested: Western medicine plus Chinese medicine (acupuncture or herbs) vs Western medicine alone
studies.who: 58 studies, 6,339 stroke patients
studies.result: Acupuncture added to standard care improved dependency and swallowing; possible benefit for depression. Short studies with high risk of bias.

studies.title: Huperzine A for Alzheimer's Disease
studies.tested: Huperzine A vs placebo
studies.who: 6 trials, 454 patients with Alzheimer's disease
studies.result: Improved MMSE at 6 and 12 weeks, global status, behavior and daily function, with mild side effects. Not better on HDS or WMS. Only one trial was adequate quality.
